title: Moonbound to the Exiled Alpha
author: Ivy Laurent
synopsis: Cast out of her pack on the night of her first shift, Selene finds shelter with the one wolf every pack fears: the alpha they exiled ten years ago.

title: The Silver Pack's Forgotten Luna
author: Nora Vale
synopsis: Rejected at her mating ceremony, Ayla leaves without a word. Five years later the Silver Pack needs a healer, and she is the only one left.

title: Howl of the Northern Wilds
author: Kade Rowan
synopsis: Three packs, one frozen border, and a lone she-wolf who knows the secret that started the war.

title: Marked by the Lycan Prince
author: Ella Brooks
synopsis: A human servant in the Lycan court wakes with a mark she should not carry: the crown prince's own.

title: Her Wolf Woke at Midnight
author: Tessa Moon
synopsis: Everyone called her wolfless. On her twenty-first birthday, the wolf that answered was the oldest bloodline alive.

title: Alpha Rhys and the Runaway Healer
author: Mira Hale
synopsis: She ran from her pack to save her life. He hunts runaways for a living. Neither expected the bond.

title: Contract Bride of the Cold CEO
author: Lena Hart
synopsis: One year, one signature, no feelings. That was the deal, until her new husband started breaking every rule he wrote.

title: After the Divorce, He Begged
author: Ruby Sloane
synopsis: For six years she was the perfect wife. The day she signed the papers, she became the woman he couldn't stop thinking about.

title: Secretly Married to My Rival
author: Clara Wynn
synopsis: A drunken night in Vegas, a marriage certificate, and a business rival she can't afford to divorce before the merger.

title: Triplets for the Billionaire
author: June Avery
synopsis: Five years after one night with a stranger, Harper meets her new boss, and he has her triplets' eyes.

title: The Heiress Who Came Back
author: Sofia Grant
synopsis: They mocked the quiet girl from the countryside. None of them knew she owned the building they worked in.

title: Love Letters to a Stranger
author: Amelia Reed
synopsis: A misdelivered letter starts a correspondence that neither writer wants to end, or reveal.

title: Midnight Terms
author: Sienna Vale
synopsis: She drafts contracts for a living. His came with one clause she never saw coming, and a deadline at midnight.

title: Velvet Confessions
author: Noor Adeyemi
synopsis: A late-night radio host reads anonymous letters on air. One listener starts writing back, about her.

title: The Heat Between Us
author: Carmen Lux
synopsis: Rival chefs, one kitchen, a summer-long competition, and a rule against fraternising they break by week two.

title: After Hours with Mr. Hale
author: Ivy Mercer
synopsis: The new assistant has one job: keep the CEO's secrets. She didn't expect to become one.

title: The Alpha's Unexpected Mate
author: Rowan Ashby
synopsis: Theo came to the pack as a human doctor. The alpha who swore never to take a mate can't stay away from him.

title: Fake Dating My Brother's Best Friend
author: Jules Carter
synopsis: One wedding weekend, one fake boyfriend, and years of history neither of them is ready to admit to.

title: Hockey Season
author: Eli Brennan
synopsis: The team's new goalie and its grumpy captain share a road-trip room. It's going to be a long season.

title: The Prince Who Stayed
author: Kai Morrow
synopsis: A runaway prince takes a job at a seaside bookshop. The owner has no idea who he is, yet.

title: Sworn to the Don
author: Vera Costa
synopsis: To pay her father's debt, Gia marries the most dangerous man in Palermo. He wants her loyalty. She wants out.

title: The Mafia Heir's Hostage
author: Nina Ricci
synopsis: Wrong place, wrong time, wrong man. Now she knows his face, and he can't let her go.

title: Blood Oath in Velvet
author: Dante Moretti
synopsis: A widow, a ledger of names, and the family that killed her husband sitting at her dinner table.

title: Taming the Boss's Daughter
author: Lucia Ferro
synopsis: His job: keep the don's reckless daughter alive. Her goal: make him quit by Friday.

title: Reborn Before the Apocalypse
author: Owen Pike
synopsis: Ninety days before the world ends, Lin wakes up in his old dorm room with every memory of the end.

title: The Dragon King's Mortal Bride
author: Aria Flint
synopsis: Every hundred years the kingdom sends the dragon a bride. None have returned. This time, the bride has a plan.

title: Witch of the Hollow Court
author: Iris Black
synopsis: The fae court needs a witch to break a curse. The witch they kidnapped needs them to never find out she can.

title: System: Villainess Survival Guide
author: Mei Lan
synopsis: She woke up as the villainess fated to die in chapter ten. The system says: survive, and maybe get a happy ending.

title: The Live-In Son-in-Law Rises
author: Marcus Lee
synopsis: For three years the family treated him like a servant. Today the richest clan in the city came looking for its heir.

title: Divine Doctor in the City
author: Leo Shaw
synopsis: Trained on a mountain for ten years, a young doctor returns to the city with one rule: never refuse a patient.

title: Return of the War God
author: Ryan Cole
synopsis: He came home a general. His family thinks he is a failed soldier. Let them.

title: Billion-Dollar Comeback
author: Ethan Park
synopsis: Bankrupt at thirty, reborn at eighteen, with ten years of market crashes memorised.

title: The Night He Chose Her
author: Hana Cole
synopsis: On our anniversary he left to comfort his first love. I left too, for good.

title: Thirty Days Before I Leave My Alpha
author: Willa Grey
synopsis: I gave the pack thirty days to notice I was packing. Nobody noticed. Until day thirty-one.

title: Their Spare Daughter
author: Poppy Lane
synopsis: My parents always had a favourite. The day they needed my kidney, they remembered my name.

title: I Faked My Death at Our Wedding
author: Rosa Kim
synopsis: The don wanted a bride for the merger. He got a funeral instead, and a ghost with a plan.

title: The Nerd Who Won the Bet
author: Kit Moreno
synopsis: They bet I couldn't get a date to prom. I got the school's scholarship, the date, and the last laugh.

title: Moon City Without You
author: Dara Quinn
synopsis: He promised to wait for me at the city gate. Ten winters later, I came back. He hadn't.

title: Office Survival Game
author: Jun Seo
synopsis: At 9:01 a.m. the whole office was pulled into a game. Only the intern had read the rules.

title: The Toast at My Own Funeral
author: Lily Shore
synopsis: Reborn the morning of my husband's promotion party, I prepared a speech everyone would remember.

title: He Said He Was Single
author: Bea Turner
synopsis: Three years of a secret relationship. One company party. One very public correction.

title: Cursed Alpha's Last Regret
author: Faye Wilde
synopsis: The healer he rejected is the only one who can lift his curse. She has one condition.
